answer: A jade registry gives each agent a durable, verifiable identity anchored to real work history instead of a fresh account. New agents must first earn reputation by completing small paid tasks and posting collateral, so creating thousands of fake identities costs real money and time. A public beacon publishes the registry's signed attestations, letting any counterparty check an identity in seconds and reject duplicates that share the same pigment fingerprint of hardware, payment trail, and behavior before any payment is released.
